notes.title: Update (07.04.2017)
notes.content:
- renaming "average time" to "needed time"
- optimizations, more FPS!
- changed "needed time" at all levels

notes.title: Update (21.02.2017)
notes.content:
- Time counting engine was updated
  - The average time of each level was updated
  - Names of users were added (from Steam)
  - User levels were added
  - Now after exit from the gaming level, you’ll get in the list of levels
  - Steam Achievements were added
  - Render and the capacity on the CPU were optimized (+12 FPS)
  - Displaying of FPS was added, you can switch it on in settings
  - First enchantment was added
  - New level was added
  - Small changes on the 2 level
  - Small changes on the 3 level
  - Small changes on the 4 level
  - Small changes on the 6 level

notes.content:
12 - trading cards (drop out every hour)
